plan.title: SRC-AWD-028 — Award bids to Vendor B and reject proposal

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ in Master QCS; the event and its two bids already exist.
Open the awarding screen for the available line and vendor bids.
Allocate the available 10-unit line to Vendor B; the second requested line is unavailable in the prepared state.
Verify that one of two bidding vendors is selected and the available allocation totals 10 × 90 = 900.
Create the award proposal from the allocation.
Verify that the proposal page opened.
